assessment.diversity_evidence: All twenty stories share the same wish to play a duet, Mateo’s initial reluctance, and Nia’s decision to perform a solo. Most end with Nia accepting the refusal and the drums on the shelf (for example, s000028 and s000057); a smaller branch has Mateo invite a private duet (s000036 and s000048). These are limited outcome variations within one basic plot, with nearly identical language throughout this sample.

plot_groups.summary: Mateo is not ready to play a duet, so Nia chooses and performs a solo, accepting his choice or hearing his refusal repeated; the story closes with the drums on the shelf.
After Mateo initially hesitates and Nia begins with a solo, he asks to play privately, and they perform a duet together.
